बॉलीवुड की खूबसूरत हसीना Shraddha Kapoor ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर अपनी आने वाली फिल्म से एक नया धमाका कर दिया है! 💥

खबर के मुताबिक Shraddha Kapoor की मच-अवेटेड फिल्म Eetha के All-India डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन राइट्स PVR Inox ने पूरे 90 crore रुपये की भारी रकम में खरीद लिए हैं। 😲

आपको बता दें कि फिल्म Eetha में Shraddha Kapoor मशहूर लावणी लीजेंड Vithabai Narayangaonkar का पावरफुल रोल निभाती हुई नजर आ रही हैं। 🎭

फिल्म के हालिया ट्रेलर में Shraddha Kapoor ने Vithabai Narayangaonkar के सफर में जान फूंक दी है और उनके इस रोल की खूब चर्चा हो रही है। 🔥

PVR Inox द्वारा 90 crore रुपये की इतनी बड़ी डील हासिल करने के बाद अब ट्रेड गल्यारों में फिल्म को लेकर काफी हलचल मच गई है। 📈

क्या आप Shraddha Kapoor को लावणी लीजेंड के इस खास अंदाज में देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: EXCLUSIVE: Shraddha Kapoor's Eetha fetches whopping Rs 90 crore from PVR Inox for All-India distribution
ctx.summary:
After the humongous success of Stree 2, Shraddha Kapoor is returning to the big screen with Eetha, a film based on the real-life stories of several Tamasha artists. The trailer was released a few days ago and received an overwhelming response from the audience. Slated to hit the big screens on December 4, the movie is already making headlines for its grandeur, its depiction of Marathi culture, the actor's never-seen-before avatar, and its box office potential. And now, we have an exciting update that will make every  Shraddha Kapoor  fan smile. 
 Pinkvilla has exclusively learnt that PVR Inox has bagged the domestic distribution rights of  Eetha  for a whopping amount of Rs. 90 crore. The deal is said to be on an advance basis. That's a big deal, especially for a women-centric film. The distributor has shown huge confidence in Eetha's box office potential, with many considering it to be a dark horse of 2026. 
 For the unversed, Eetha marks the first-ever collaboration between Shraddha Kapoor and director Laxman Utekar. Both of them are coming together after delivering Rs. 500 crore grossers each with  Stree 2  and Chhaava, respectively. Backed by Maddock Films, Eetha also stars Randeep Hooda, Mohd. Zeeshan Ayyub, Siddharth Jadhav, and others. Ajay-Atul have composed the music for Eetha, which is touted to be one of the strongest highlights of the film. 
 Stay tuned to Pinkvilla for more box office updates.
